description: This dataset records twenty quick‑look image files generated during a single ROV survey conducted on 8 September 2020. All rows share the same survey identifier (1) and event label (PS122/5_61‑35), and they are geolocated at latitude 88.675993 ° N, longitude 112.324519 ° E with an elevation of –4291.4 m, indicating a deep‑water deployment. The **Date/Time** column provides a day‑level timestamp, the **Survey ID** serves as a numeric identifier, and the **Binary** field lists the PNG filenames that reference each image. The **Event** column denotes the specific marine‑survey segment, while **Latitude**, **Longitude**, and **Elevation** capture precise geospatial measurements. Researchers can use these records to visualise ROV observations, assess seabed and water‑column conditions, and support mapping or environmental monitoring of deep‑sea habitats.
